captions.detailed: This 3D model is a compact, rectangular keystone jack mounting frame. It features a large central rectangular cutout designed to fit a standard RJ-45 keystone jack. Inside the cutout, there are recessed ledge details and small integrated retaining clips on the short inner walls to securely snap-fit the jack in place.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric OpenSCAD script to generate a keystone jack mount. The design should allow the user to adjust the jack length and width, wall height and thickness, as well as the overhang and clearance of the retaining clips.
captions.factory: The design uses a 'clip_catch' helper module that extrudes a 2D polygon along a rotated axis to form the wedge-shaped latch. The main 'keystone' module constructs the outer body using a 3D cube, then subtracts two nested cubes using the 'difference' operator to establish the central opening and internal ledges. Finally, the 'union' operator combines this modified body with additional structural cubes and two instances of the 'clip_catch' module positioned at opposite ends.
